texts.about.name: LYDIA WONG
texts.about.zh:
我来自怡保，也住过许多不同的城市。近2023年, 我第一次接触陶作，当时主要是因为治疗忧郁症而有机会尝试---从中学习慢下脚步去思考、养伤、及成长。

目前 the makers clay 是个人团队，而我的丈夫与孩子是我的铁粉。我喜欢简单与安静，也喜欢透过日常趣味的东西找到并给予情绪的一个出口。

面对忧郁很艰难，陶作也不容易---这些磨练虽然没有让我变得更强大，却让我看见我依然像陶瓷一样脆弱。可是虽然脆弱，我有那造我的那一位强大的原创者做我的永恒的堡垒。
texts.about.en:
I was born in Ipoh, and lived in various cities in different parts of the world. In the recent years, I was introduced to pottery, mainly was to help cope with my prolonged depression. Through smashing, pinching, smoothing and waiting in the process, I had a chance to slow down my heart and racing thoughts to think, recover, and grow.

At the moment, I'm a solo team--along with my hubby and son as my top permanent fans. I like simpleness and quietness, and I enjoy discovering and expressing my emotions and passions through many simple yet meaningful daily stuff.

It is extremely hard coping with depression, and pottery is not easy either - battling with them didn't make me stronger. I am still the weak vessel, but I know an almighty potter, who is my Creator, to be my fortress forever.
